answer: Bind one slashable bond to a unique hardware attestation per agent, and weight each vote by the stake actually locked rather than by headcount. A Sybil attacker must then fund a separate bond for every fake identity, and loses the entire deposit when an audit catches one key double-voting, so the price of each extra vote is a fresh, unrecoverable payment. In this tariff, a thin copper bond earns little voice, a pearl bond earns weight, and a saffron audit flag singles out clones for slashing. Manufacturing thousands of personas turns into a guaranteed loss.
